organization.name: EEZ Association
organization.summary: Association named in the proposal as doing the work. Its public repository is in the GitHub organization eez-association. Legal form and registration were not found.

claims.claim: The protocol is public at eez-core-protocol.
claims.method: GitHub API: created 2026-01-28, last push 2026-11-27, no license field and no releases. Top-level folders include src, test, docs, script and deployment.

Snapshot hub API: space gnosis.eth, status closed, scores For about 123,158, Against about 115, Abstain about 151. The GIP body states it asks for alignment on direction and requests no funds. Quorum rules were not checked.

claims.claim: Gnosis Chain is the first governance-backed adopter.
claims.method: Only the opening part of the GIP text was read. No source was found that confirms or contradicts the ordering.

claims.claim: Gnosis commits $30,000 to this goal and hosts the testnet nodes.
claims.method: GIP-153 does not state a $30,000 commitment in the text searched (it says no funds are requested). No other public source was found.

claims.claim: Vitalik Buterin stress-tested the design with Jordi Baylina at ETHPrague 2026 and called EEZ 'a quite helpful effort' at Dappcon Berlin.
claims.method: YouTube oEmbed confirms the videos exist: 'Vitalik & Jordi Baylina Fireside chat' (Duct Tape) and 'Vitalik Buterin and Friederike Ernst. Ethereum Economic Zone' (Dappcon Berlin). The spoken words were not checked.

claims.claim: Celo, Polygon and Linea agreed in discussions to test the audited contracts.
claims.method: A statement about private discussions. No public source was found.
